evidence: custom_ops.cu defines extern "C" softmax_dim2_launcher(float*, const float*, int, int, int, cudaStream_t) and elu_launcher(float*, const float*, int, float, cudaStream_t).
custom_ops_contract.json specifies softmax_dim2 with one tensor parameter and elu with tensor and optional alpha float default 1.0.
changes: Create kernels/custom_ops_binding.cpp with tensor validation, contiguous enforcement, allocation via torch::empty_like, current CUDA stream retrieval, launcher invocation, error checking.
Register both functions under names softmax_dim2 and elu using REGISTER_BINDING.
